title: Entity growth batch 04 — group A
notes: Breadth-first candidate group for Issue #203. Canonical publication prohibited until candidate validation and manual review complete. Manual review completed 2026-08-20: identity, selected runtime, lifecycle, custody, dates and evidence boundaries accepted for canonical promotion subject to final validation.

entities.summary: Self-custody Web3 wallet from Coinbase, distinct from custodial Coinbase.com account balances and other Coinbase-hosted wallet products.
entities.notes: Current Coinbase first-party material explicitly distinguishes Coinbase Wallet self-custody from Coinbase.com hosted balances and the separate split-key Web3 wallet. Initial Coinbase Wallet lineage date remains unresolved in this breadth pass.

entities.summary: Non-custodial multichain wallet ecosystem from Ava Labs covering Avalanche, EVM networks and Bitcoin across extension, mobile and web surfaces.
entities.notes: Current first-party Core documentation explicitly describes Core as non-custodial and separates web, browser-extension and mobile surfaces. Avalanche ecosystem history is not reused as a wallet launch date.

entities.summary: Open-source non-custodial Bitcoin wallet ecosystem from UniSat for BTC and newer Bitcoin asset standards across browser and mobile surfaces.
entities.notes: Current UniSat first-party documentation explicitly describes UniSat Wallet as open-source and non-custodial and distinguishes the wallet from UniSat Marketplace, Inscribe and other services. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Non-custodial wallet ecosystem for TON and supported networks, distributed across mobile and other wallet surfaces by the Tonkeeper team.
entities.notes: Tonkeeper's current first-party material describes the wallet as non-custodial and states Tonkeeper was founded in 2021. WLR records year precision only.

entities.summary: Open-source self-custodial multichain wallet formerly branded MyTonWallet, now distributed as My Wallet across mobile, browser-extension and desktop surfaces.
entities.notes: Current first-party site explicitly states that My Wallet was formerly known as MyTonWallet. WLR preserves one continuous entity lineage rather than treating the rebrand as a new wallet launch. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Coinbase Wallet self-custody mobile application, kept separate from custodial Coinbase.com balances and Coinbase's separate split-key Web3 wallet.
products.notes: Selected mobile runtime for the breadth pass. Browser/extension surfaces are deferred rather than collapsed into the same product boundary.

products.summary: Core non-custodial browser extension for Avalanche and supported networks.
products.notes: Selected extension runtime only; Core mobile and web are distinct surfaces and deferred. Current first-party support says the extension is officially supported on Chrome.

products.summary: UniSat open-source non-custodial Bitcoin browser-extension wallet.
products.notes: Selected browser-extension runtime only; iOS and Android wallet applications are deferred.

products.summary: Tonkeeper non-custodial mobile wallet application for TON and supported assets/services.
products.notes: Current first-party privacy material identifies Tonkeeper's App Store/Google Play application and dates the privacy policy to 2021; Tonkeeper also states it was founded in 2021. Year precision only.

products.summary: Current self-custodial My Wallet mobile application, preserving the former MyTonWallet product lineage.
products.notes: Selected mobile runtime only. Browser extension, desktop and Telegram mini-app surfaces are deferred. Rebrand does not reset launch chronology.

evidence.title: Coinbase Wallet | Safety & Security
evidence.notes: Current Coinbase page explicitly calls Coinbase Wallet a self-custody Web3 wallet and says users control the private keys.

evidence.title: Web3 wallet, Coinbase.com & Coinbase Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party help explicitly distinguishes self-custodied Coinbase Wallet from Coinbase.com custody and the separate split-key Web3 wallet.

evidence.title: Core Documentation — Introduction
evidence.notes: Current first-party Core documentation describes Core as a non-custodial crypto wallet and lists web, extension, iOS and Android surfaces.

evidence.title: What is the Core extension?
evidence.notes: Current first-party support identifies Core extension as a free non-custodial browser extension and states current official Chrome support.

evidence.title: UniSat Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party documentation describes UniSat Wallet as open-source, non-custodial and separate from marketplace/inscription/other integrated services.

evidence.title: UniSat Wallet Download
evidence.notes: Current first-party distribution page confirms the open-source non-custodial Chrome extension and separately lists iOS/Android downloads.

evidence.title: Tonkeeper Terms of Use
evidence.notes: Current first-party terms describe Tonkeeper as a self-hosted non-custodial wallet whose servers do not store private keys or backup phrases.

evidence.title: Tonkeeper Signer
evidence.notes: Current first-party Tonkeeper page describes Tonkeeper as the non-custodial TON wallet and states it was founded in 2021; used only for year-level lineage.

evidence.title: My Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party site describes My Wallet as fully self-custodial and explicitly states that it was formerly known as MyTonWallet.

evidence.title: Install My Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party distribution surface for the renamed My Wallet product family; mobile is selected for this breadth pass while other runtimes are deferred.
